subject: Finlytics POC - success criteria, evaluation plan & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Anna Brooks <anna.brooks@finlytics.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Finlytics POC - success criteria, evaluation plan & next steps

Hi Anna / Tom — great to meet you both on the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment heading into the POC: 

Summary of scope
- Two-week POC to validate Redwood inference for Finlytics’ real-time insights workload (dashboarding + ad-hoc queries).
- Focus areas: latency, cost, integration simplicity, and output correctness on your sample prompts.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
1) Latency: 95th percentile tail latency < 200ms at 512-token median request size for burst workloads in US-west region.
2) Quality: >= 92% pass rate vs your gold prompt set (we’ll import your evaluation set).
3) Cost: Target unit cost <= $X per 1M tokens (we'll finalize once we see throughput).
4) Integration: API integration and example dashboard queries working end-to-end by end of week 2.

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): Share SOW & eval criteria (attached). Redwood provides a dedicated test environment and onboarding guide.
- Week 1: Connect sample data, run integration tests, baseline measurements.
- Week 2: Run sustained load/latency tests, run eval scripts, collect outputs for quality review.
- End of Week 2: Joint review call to go/no-go and next-step recommendation.

Ownership (who does what)
- Finlytics: Provide sample prompt set, evaluation gold labels, and a small dataset (Anonymized) by EOD Friday (Anna/Tom).
- Redwood: Environment and test harness (Rishi) + integration support (Marcus).
- Commercial/Contract: I’ll follow up with an SOW/PO path (cc procurement if needed).

Immediate next steps
- Anna: Share the evaluation spreadsheet + a redacted dataset by Friday (7/17).
- Rishi: Provision dedicated POC pool and share access + runbook by Tuesday (7/20).
- Marcus: Schedule 30-min kickoff once access is available.

Attachments: Finlytics-POC-SOW-v1.pdf, finlytics-eval-criteria.xlsx

If any of the success criteria above need to change, flag them here and we’ll adjust. Planning to schedule the kickoff for Tue 7/21 but flexible.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
